No `.specify/extensions.yml`, so no post-implement hooks. Implementation is complete and running. Here's the completion report.

## ✅ Implementation complete — Bookmark Manager

All **82 tasks** in `tasks.md` are done and marked `[X]`, validated against the approved spec by **47 passing automated tests**. The app is **running for your review at `http://maker:4000`** (clean, empty state, ready to use).

### What was built
A single-user, self-contained web app (Node.js + Express + embedded SQLite, React/Vite UI, Chromium via Playwright for enrichment/snapshots). One `npm start` serves the API and UI on `0.0.0.0:4000`; all data lives under `data/` — no external services needed.

Every approved user story is implemented and test-covered:

| | Story | Verified by |
|---|---|---|
| P1 | Save + auto-enrich (title/description/favicon/preview), edit all fields | E2E + API |
| P1 | No duplicates → route to existing (trailing-slash/host-case aware) | E2E |
| P1 | Browse, sort, open, empty/no-results states | E2E |
| P1 | Advanced search (fields, case-insensitive, `#tag`, phrases, AND/OR/NOT, parens, implicit AND, quoted-operator-as-text, malformed→error) | 12 unit + E2E |
| P2 | Read-later (not auto-set) + unread view | E2E |
| P2 | Tags + type-ahead suggestions + include/exclude filter | E2E |
| P2 | Markdown notes (rendered + sanitized) | E2E |
| P2 | Bulk & view-wide actions (add/remove tags, read/unread, archive, delete) | E2E |
| P2 | Archive vs delete (restore; **single-delete confirmation**) | E2E |
| P3 | Saved views | E2E |
| P3 | Import/export (Netscape HTML, titles/tags/dates, no dup) | node + E2E |
| P3 | Self-contained single-HTML snapshots (renders offline), PDFs as PDFs, Internet Archive, **all outcomes visibly surfaced** | E2E (offline render + visible-failure checks) |
| P3 | Display preferences (default sort, items, font size) | E2E |

**Test tally:** 21 vitest unit · 4 import/export (node) · 1 **restart-persistence** (spawns→kills→restarts the real process, checks SC-007) · 21 Playwright browser E2E. Search returns in **4–22 ms at 5,000 bookmarks** (target was <1 s).

### Fidelity issues I caught and fixed during implementation
Routed through the spec (no vibe-patching): user-supplied title/description are no longer clobbered by auto-enrichment; searching *within* the archive view now works; the default-sort preference actually drives the list; single-delete confirmation is wired through the shared confirm dialog. I also added US9 acceptance scenario 5 to the spec for single-delete confirmation and T082 for restart persistence.

### Two honest implementation notes
- **Search matching uses SQL `LIKE` (case-insensitive substring)** rather than the FTS5 index the plan mentioned — because your spec requires *substring* matching, which FTS5's token matching wouldn't satisfy. The FTS table exists but the executor uses `LIKE`; performance is well within target.
- A native `better-sqlite3`/Node 24 crash on statement garbage-collection was the root cause of early flakiness; fixed by caching prepared statements (also faster). The DB-backed tests run under Node's test runner (not vitest's worker pool) to avoid the same teardown issue.
- Frontend files are slightly consolidated vs. the task paths (e.g. components in `components.jsx`/`pages.jsx` rather than one file each) — functionally equivalent and complete.

You can review the app now at **`http://maker:4000`** — add a URL and watch it auto-enrich, try the search operators, tags, archive/restore, import/export, and preferences. Let me know what you'd like adjusted; any change will go back through the spec first, per our workflow.
